name: The St. Regis Kanai Resort, Riviera Maya
positioning: St. Regis resort built on a natural mangrove reserve in Kanai, near Cancun and Playa del Carmen, with architecture inspired by the Pleiades constellation
best_for: Travelers who want St. Regis Butler Service in every room category
Families who want a children's club with its own pool
Spa-focused stays with a hydrotherapy area

facts.text: The resort is in Kanai, Mexico, near Cancun and Playa del Carmen.
The resort is built on a natural mangrove reserve.
The architecture is by Edmonds International.
The interior design is by Toronto-based Chapi Chapo design.
Guests reach restaurants and beach clubs on wooden walkways, with golf cart transport as an option.
Every room features a private terrace or plunge pool.
Room headboards are walnut wood walls carved in a pattern based on Mayan textiles.
Toro serves dishes reflecting Mexico and Latin America under the direction of Chef Richard Sandoval.
The St. Regis Bar is on the top floor of the resort.
Riviera is a seafood restaurant drawing on the flavors of Mexico's Pacific and Caribbean coasts.
The St. Regis Spa offers Mayan-infused services inspired by Mayan cosmology.
The Tortuga Children's Club has its own pool.

highlights.text: The resort's architecture was inspired by the Pleiades constellation and floats above the mangrove canopy.
The resort was built as a suspended structure with elevated walkways so it does not disturb the root systems of the 400-year-old mangrove.
The St. Regis Bar features an expansive mural inspired by Maya astronomer-priests.
The Library hosts afternoon tea and Mexican chocolate tastings.
Guests in all room categories have access to St. Regis Butler Service.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Cancun International Airport is about 28.7 miles from the hotel.
June is typically exceedingly hot and humid at the resort.
